excerpt: Sancta Teresia Bendedicta a Cruce, virgo et martyr, Patrona caelestis loci v.d. Lubliniec, Gliwice, Polonia (28 apr. 2007, Prot. 1349/06/L).

summary_en: St Maria De Mattias, virgin, is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the town of Bolesławiec, diocese of Legnica (Poland); patron of a single town.
excerpt: Sancta Maria de Mattias, virgo: Patrona caelestis loci v.d. Bolesławiec, Legnica Polonia (23 maii 2007, Prot. 38/07/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Immaculata Conceptione

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of the Immaculate Conception is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the military chaplains in Spain; patron of a category of persons (armed forces).
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo de Immaculata Conceptione: Patrona caelestis capellanorum militum in Hispania (26 iun. 2007, Prot. 646/07/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Marianus de la Mata Aparicio, presbyter

summary_en: Liturgical celebrations in honour of Blessed Mariano de la Mata Aparicio, priest, are granted to the Augustinians; the same protocol approves the Latin collect and Office reading (Approbatio textuum, p. 372, not recorded separately).
excerpt: Agostiniani: Liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beati Mariani de la Mata Aparicio, presbyteri (3 ian. 2007, Prot. 1330/06/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Antonius Maria Moreau, presbyter et fundator

summary_en: Liturgical celebrations in honour of Blessed Basil Anthony Mary Moreau, priest and founder, are granted to the Congregation of Holy Cross; the same protocol approves the collect texts (Approbatio textuum, pp. 372 and 376, not recorded separately).
excerpt: Congregazione di Santa Croce: Liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beati Antonii Mariae Moreau, presbyteri et fundatoris (15 maii 2007, Prot. 1552/06/L).

target.institute: Piccole Serve del Sacro Cuore di Gesù

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Carolus Liviero, episcopus et fundator

summary_en: Liturgical celebrations in honour of Blessed Carlo Liviero, bishop and founder, are granted to the Little Servants of the Sacred Heart of Jesus; the same protocol approves the collect and Office reading (Approbatio textuum, pp. 373 and 377, not recorded separately).
excerpt: Piccole Serve del Sacro Cuore di Gesù: Liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beati Caroli Liviero, episcopi et fundatoris (23 maii 2007, Prot. 478/07/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Magdalena Starace, virgo et fundatrix

summary_en: Liturgical celebrations in honour of Blessed Maria Maddalena Starace, virgin and foundress, are granted to the Servants of Mary (Servites); the same protocol approves the collect and Office reading (Approbatio textuum, p. 377, not recorded separately).
excerpt: Servi di Maria: Liturgicae celebrationes conceduntur in honorem Beatae Mariae Magdalenae Starace, virginis et fundatricis (30 mar. 2007, Prot. 1563/06/L).
